questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A group of lions"
questions.explanation: The word is "pride": the collective noun for lions. Do not confuse it with "herd": a group of cattle, elephants or deer.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "A group of wolves or hunting dogs"
questions.explanation: The word is "pack": the collective noun for wolves or hounds. Do not confuse it with "pride": a group of lions.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "A group of sheep"
questions.explanation: The word is "flock": the collective noun for sheep, and also for birds. Do not confuse it with "pride": a group of lions.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "A group of cattle or elephants"
questions.explanation: The word is "herd": the collective noun for cattle and elephants. Do not confuse it with "flock": a group of sheep or birds.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A group of fish swimming together"
questions.explanation: The word is "shoal": the collective noun for fish. Do not confuse it with "swarm": a large group of flying insects such as bees.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "A group of bees flying together"
questions.explanation: The word is "swarm": the collective noun for bees and other flying insects. Do not confuse it with "shoal": a group of fish.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "A group of ships sailing together under one command"
questions.explanation: The word is "fleet": a number of ships under one command. Do not confuse it with "squad": a small group of soldiers or workers.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "A group of singers performing together"
questions.explanation: The word is "choir": an organised group of singers. Do not confuse it with "orchestra": a group of instrumentalists.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A group of musicians playing different instruments together"
questions.explanation: The word is "orchestra": a large group of instrumentalists. Do not confuse it with "choir": a group of singers.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "A group of newborn puppies or kittens born at one time"
questions.explanation: The word is "litter": the young born to an animal at one birth. Do not confuse it with "brood": the young birds hatched together.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "A group of eggs laid or hatched at one time"
questions.explanation: The word is "clutch": a set of eggs laid by a bird in one nest. Do not confuse it with "litter": the young born to a mammal at one birth.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "A group of young birds hatched together and cared for by the mother"
questions.explanation: The word is "brood": the young birds hatched at one time. Do not confuse it with "litter": the young of mammals born at one birth.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A group of stars forming a recognised pattern in the sky"
questions.explanation: The word is "constellation": a named pattern of stars. Do not confuse it with "galaxy": a vast system of millions of stars.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "A group of steps between two floors"
questions.explanation: The word is "flight": a series of stairs between landings. Do not confuse it with "fleet": a group of ships.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "A number of grapes growing together"
questions.explanation: The word is "bunch": a cluster of fruit such as grapes or bananas on one stem. Do not confuse it with "flock": a group of animals, especially sheep.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "A group of actors performing together on stage"
questions.explanation: The word is "troupe": a company of actors or performers. Do not confuse it with "troop": a group of soldiers or scouts.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A group of soldiers, especially on the march"
questions.explanation: The word is "troop": a body of soldiers or scouts. Do not confuse it with "troupe": a company of actors or acrobats.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The people who work together on a ship or aircraft"
questions.explanation: The word is "crew": the people operating a ship, aircraft or train. Do not confuse it with "staff": the permanent employees of an organisation.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "A group of people gathered to hear a speaker or performance"
questions.explanation: The word is "audience": the people attending a performance or speech to listen. Do not confuse it with "mob": a large disorderly crowd.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "A group of worshippers gathered in a place of worship"
questions.explanation: The word is "congregation": a group assembled for religious worship. Do not confuse it with "audience": people gathered to listen to or watch a performance.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A group of cards used in a game"
questions.explanation: The word is "pack": a complete set of playing cards. Do not confuse it with "bunch": things growing together on a stem.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "A group of geese flying in a V-formation"
questions.explanation: The word is "skein": a flight of geese or wild fowl in the air. Do not confuse it with "gaggle": geese on the ground, a noisy group.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "A group of geese on the ground"
questions.explanation: The word is "gaggle": a collective noun for geese when they are not flying. Do not confuse it with "skein": geese flying in formation.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "A group of owls"
questions.explanation: The word is "parliament": the traditional collective noun for owls. Do not confuse it with "senate": a ruling body, not a group of birds.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A group of crows"
questions.explanation: The word is "murder": the traditional collective noun for crows. Do not confuse it with "flock": the collective noun for lions.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "A group of officers chosen to conduct some business on behalf of a larger body"
questions.explanation: The word is "committee": a group appointed to carry out a specific task. Do not confuse it with "audience": people gathered to listen or watch.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "A group of mountains forming a connected chain"
questions.explanation: The word is "range": a line of connected mountains. Do not confuse it with "cluster": a number of similar things close together.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "A group of islands"
questions.explanation: The word is "archipelago": a chain or cluster of islands. Do not confuse it with "peninsula": a piece of land almost surrounded by water.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A group of travellers or merchants journeying together across a desert"
questions.explanation: The word is "caravan": a company travelling together through desert or hazardous country. Do not confuse it with "fleet": a number of ships under one command.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "A large number of people gathered together in a disorderly manner"
questions.explanation: The word is "mob": a large disorderly crowd. Do not confuse it with "audience": people gathered to hear a performance.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "A group of criminals or hooligans acting together"
questions.explanation: The word is "gang": a group of people, often criminals, acting together. Do not confuse it with "pack": a group of wolves or hunting dogs.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "The employees who work in an office, school or hospital"
questions.explanation: The word is "staff": the people employed by an organisation. Do not confuse it with "crew": the people operating a ship or aircraft.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A number of cattle or sheep driven together"
questions.explanation: The word is "drove": a number of cattle or sheep driven in a body. Do not confuse it with "troupe": a company of actors.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "A group of players forming one side in a game"
questions.explanation: The word is "team": a group of players forming one side in a sport. Do not confuse it with "gang": a group of criminals acting together.
